label_definition: absolute zero: (Y,T) relative to the pose whose image equals center.bmp; per-session command offsets removed
training_recipe: shared normalized Huber IRLS6, ridge1e-7, no augmentation
scope: All 702 in-range development photos fitted for deployment (ID 702 and T=+2.00 photos excluded). Cross-validation evidence is in evidence/.
input_contract: single 3840x2160 uint8 image; no labels, date or filename in inference
known_limits: vertical displacements are not used, so vertical faults are not detected; photos without all 536 valid QR points are rejected; new-machine transfer and closed-loop return are not validated

ncc.note: same photos, labels and splits as the default model; QR value measured with NCC after Gaussian sigma 2 blur (3-point parabola)
